correctness.rationale: Finite-time detailed balance yields product of vertex-degree powers; the resulting exact coefficient partition formula counts all hub, ordinary and pendant occupations. With r fixed and M/n->rho>0, fixed outside occupation weights converge to r^s/s!, while a uniform exponential-factorial bound and leaf generating function control all tails. Simplex Riemann sums give an exponential-tilt limit conditionally on each fixed outside total, proving independent Poisson and simplex limits. The verifier also passed 2169 exact finite and convergence-bound comparisons from the supplied package. No finite computation is used as an infinite proof.

value.rationale: The fixed-r family quantifies a physically natural critical competition among equal-leading-degree hubs: finite pendant graph edits bias the macroscopic stationary occupation distribution despite vanishing relative degree differences, while ordinary vertices retain a tight Poisson population. The exact density, independence and finite-size coefficient formula provide a reproducible benchmark absent from one-hub condensation descriptions. These structural distinctions motivate the exact invariant rather than an arbitrary special case.
